General Instructions
  • 🚫
    Do not switch tabs or windows Switching to another browser tab or window will be recorded as a violation. Multiple violations may result in auto-submission of your test.
  • 📵
    Do not switch apps (mobile) On mobile devices, minimising the browser or switching to another app will trigger a warning. Keep this tab open and active.
  • 🔄
    Do not refresh or press Back Refreshing the page or using the browser's back button will end your test session and your answers will not be saved.
  • ⏱️
    Timer starts immediately The countdown begins the moment you click "Start Test" and cannot be paused. The test will auto-submit when time runs out.
  • 🖱️
    One question at a time Use the Next / Prev buttons or the Question Palette to navigate. You can change your answer any time before submission.
  • ⭐
    Mark for Review You can mark any question for review and come back to it. Marked questions that are answered will still be evaluated.
  • 💡
    Stable internet recommended This test runs entirely in your browser. Your answers are saved locally even if connectivity drops — but do not close the tab.
Marking Scheme
Each question carries 1 mark. Wrong answers attract a penalty.
